Subject: Discovery follow-through: pilot readiness, success metrics & access plan

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the thoughtful discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we spin up the pilot: 

Top pain points you shared
- High latency on your current in-house inference (spiky P95s impacting triage UX)
- Per-request cost variability; finance wants predictable unit economics for 90-day run rate
- Data residency & auditability concerns for PHI-adjacent triage messages

Goals for a successful pilot
- Latency: P95 tail under 250ms for 512-token average requests
- Quality: ~90% match to current triage routing for top-3 intents (precision-focused)
- Cost: target unit cost improvement of 30% vs current baseline

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
- Dataset: 10k de-identified triage messages (you provide), plus a 500-message eval set for prompt/eval tuning
- Model surface: hosted Redwood catalog model (we’ll suggest a quantized 7B variant) + one fallback variant for low-cost throughput
- Metrics: latency (P50/P95), token-cost per 1k, top-3 intent precision/recall, hallucination rate on structured outputs

Owners & contacts
- Aurora PM / Exec sponsor: Samantha Lee (you)
- Aurora security contact (for access & egress): Priya Anand (please confirm)
- Redwood technical lead: Karthik Iyer (cc’d) — infra + access setup
- Redwood CS / success: Ben Carter (will coordinate evals & prompts)

Access we’ll need to start
- Read-only S3 bucket (or secure SAS URL) with the de-identified dataset
- Name of the service account to grant (we can provide a minimal-permission IAM template)
- Sample prompt set and 500-message eval set delivered to the Drive folder linked below

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (timeline & milestones), redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (ops checklist)

Immediate next steps
1) Samantha: confirm service account email and Priya as security contact by Wed 7/7
2) Aurora: drop the de-id dataset into the Drive/S3 link by Fri 7/9
3) Redwood: we’ll provision a pilot environment and send the access playbook + SOC2 link by EOD 7/6

I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan (spreadsheet) after this thread — feel free to flag anything missing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
